statement: Share of firms using AI to produce goods or services >= 2x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census BTOS; 2027Q4)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2023 (2025 baseline did not exist). The BTOS AI-use question was introduced in September 2023; in-phase readings were ~3.7-3.9% of employer businesses, with the Information sector ~13.8%. These are the earliest points of the series (original question wording, later retired).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office's biweekly business survey began asking about AI use in Sept 2023; an estimated 3.9% of businesses used AI to produce goods or services in the 23 Oct-5 Nov 2023 period (headline 3.8%), with the Information sector at 13.8% and professional services at 9.1%.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau Bloc A Counts story, 'Only 3.8% of Businesses Use AI to Produce Goods and Services, Highest Use in Information Sector' (Breaux, Dinlersoz), 2023-11-28 (verified via web_extract this run). Consistent with 3.2% AI use in 2018 from the 2019 Annual Business Survey.

items.summary: Before Sept 2023 no high-frequency official series on firm AI use existed in either bloc; the series start date limits any in-phase trend.
items.detail: Per the Census story above, BTOS AI questions began in September 2023; prior official benchmark was the 2019 ABS (2018 data). No comparable Bloc B official firm-AI-use series identified in this run.
